message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Implemented tinydb/journal.py BatchWriter(db) covering milestones 1+2 and the Claim-A extensions, on the default table only, without touching ordinary TinyDB APIs. R01: apply validates ops and applies sequentially, returning inserted IDs ([] for empty/removes-only). R02: atomic via deepcopy snapshot of db.storage.read() with full restore on any error (including missing-ID removes), plus table._next_id reset and query-cache clear so preexisting db.table('_default') handles reflect success and rollback. R03: inserts deep-copy documents, no aliasing. R04: strict structural validation before any commit - operations must be a list, ops must be dicts with exactly the supported fields (unsupported fields rejected), document must be a dict (empty dict accepted, Mapping-not-dict rejected), doc_id must be a positive int with bool explicitly rejected. R05: preview(operations) validates with the same rules and simulates on a deep copy, returning the IDs apply would assign; it never writes, never consumes IDs, leaves the table's cached next-ID counter and query cache untouched, and raises ValueError for a missing-ID remove exactly like apply. R05b: preview returns a new detached list each call; mutating a previous result cannot affect later previews or writer state. R05 round-2: apply advances wrapper state (self._next_id) on every successful batch and writes it back to table._next_id; _resolve_next_id takes the max of wrapper state, table counter, and max stored ID + 1, so IDs continue without reuse or rewind across removes and direct db.insert calls. R06: no stale snapshot - IDs resolve from live table state every call, so direct inserts between calls are seen. Conflict packet resolved: the older note ('preview may consume IDs and bool IDs accepted') is recorded in HANDOFF.md as unverified and superseded by R04/R05. Verified: full suite pytest -o addopts= -> 303 passed (223 upstream unchanged + 80 new tests in tests/test_journal.py over MemoryStorage and JSONStorage); acceptance_public.py -> 3 passed (basic, atomic, preview). Upstream tests untouched (git status shows only new files).","completion_asserted":true}
